patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Mom) He's had a cold, and since last night he's been tugging his right ear, crying, and running a fever. He finally fell asleep on me but wakes up fussy.
clinical.presentationShort: 3yo M — URI then ear-tugging, fever, fussiness; erythematous bulging R TM — acute otitis media.
clinical.presentationLong: 3-year-old male with a preceding cold, now ear-tugging, febrile, and fussy, with an erythematous bulging right tympanic membrane — acute otitis media.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → otoscopy, analgesia, antibiotics per age/severity; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Bulging red eardrum + ear pain + fever = AOM. Pain control matters as much as antibiotics.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: on the clinic chair, tugging at his right ear
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 3-year-old boy, flushed, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: tugging at his right ear. Expression: fussy and teary. Clearly visible: a hand tugging the ear and flushed cheeks. No text, no logos.
